meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次用编辑类工具成功改完文件,若自动评论检查器报出警告,它会先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作成功后被触发,此时评论检查器的反馈会作为阻塞信息交给 Claude。

say.text: 修复刚才改的代码里被标记的注释
say.note: 会让 Claude 处理检查器报出的评论问题。

say.text: 解释一下这段注释为什么这样写
say.note: 如果警告可接受,它会说明理由。

say.text: 把代码里的 TODO 注释按规范改清楚
say.note: 触发检查器后让它调整注释格式。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever Claude successfully modifies a file with edit tools, if the automatic comment checker reports a warning, it will fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc., when the comment checker's feedback is passed to Claude as blocking input.

say_en.text: Fix the flagged comments in the code you just changed.
say_en.note: Claude will address the checker's warnings.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment is written this way.
say_en.note: If acceptable, it will provide reasoning.

say_en.text: Clean up TODO comments in the code per conventions.
say_en.note: Trigger the checker to adjust comment style.
